resources.string_upd: Welcome to Studio
Studio is where you set up your site: apps, design, pages, menus, forms, permissions and languages. This short tour shows where things are.
Your apps
Each tile is an app: a module, a tool, a language or a template. Apps you install show up here.
Designer
Set the logo, pick a template and edit the cover page that guests see first.
Accounts
Manage member accounts and choose who is an administrator or a moderator. They look after content and profiles on the site itself, not in Studio.
Dashboard
See how the site is doing: the UNA version, storage use, server checks and cache.
Pages
Add, remove and rearrange blocks on any page, or create new pages. Visibility and SEO settings are here too.
Permissions
Create membership levels and choose what each level can do.
Forms
Change the fields of any form, the lists they use and how each form is shown.
Navigation
Edit the menus: add, reorder and hide links, change icons and choose who sees each item.
Polyglot
Choose the site languages and edit any text on the site, including the texts of this tour.
Rearrange apps
Open this menu and choose Manage Apps to move apps around or remove the ones you do not use. You can start this tour again from here.
The Dock
Apps you opened recently stay here, one click away. In edit mode you can keep an app in the Dock.
App Store
UNA starts with the core apps. Get more here: modules, templates, languages and integrations.
This is your homepage
It fills up as your site grows. Add apps and arrange page blocks in Studio, then invite people and post something.
Your account menu
Switch profiles, check notifications and open your account settings here. You can start this tour again from this menu.
